source: Photographs provided by DOJO for its brand materials

assets.role: Readable computers on left for horizontal poster slice
assets.visualReview: Two original suspended PCs, two monitors and chairs retained. Chains retained. Original single central hanging headset retained; invented second headset and second white shelf bar in first pass were removed. Neutral wall and clearer equipment, soft red/aqua accents. Fine component and wallpaper details are generatively reconstructed, not pixel-identical.

assets.role: Full club room hero with central aisle
assets.visualReview: Both station rows, chairs, wall-mounted PC cases, central aisle, ceiling and tiled floor retained. Cosmetic chipped paint repair and dirt cleanup, lifted shadows, moderated red/aqua light. No room expansion or new equipment intended. Small screen/UI details are reconstructed.

assets.role: Real entrance and recognisable DOJO sign
assets.visualReview: Actual angled DOJO sign, roof, brick, dark entrance and map-service stickers retained. Readable wording preserved. Dust and sign-face grime reduced, exposure balanced. Small logo/lettering contours remain a generative retouch rather than vector-accurate master art.
